title: Absennde Ceniinde
intro: Gaa gaa duule jamaanu, ina woodi daartol dewal ngol ustataako e hoolaare teeŋtunde haa ruuhu jogiiɗo ɗum oo waawi taƴde. E nder wakkati nde yim6e 6ee njirlotoo e majjere e kaŋŋe, limre wootere ina darii – ina nodda 6e, ina 6eydoo muñal, ina 6eydoo teddungal fodoore ceniinde. Ko ɗum daartol gooto cuɓaaɗo ngam wonde balloowo, waziir, e gardotooɗo iimanaagal e nder absence ceniinde. Mbele aɗa waawi udditaade sifaa ooɗoo ruuhu tiiɗɗo?
clues: Miɗo renndini ƴiiƴam annabi mawɗo cuɓaaɗo ngam haaldude e Alla to bannge tufnde ceniinde.
Miñi am meeɗii ñaagaade Alla ballal e haalde laaɓɗo e tooñoowo mawɗo.
Mi suɓaama e Alla ngam daraade sara banndi am ngam wonde balloowo e waziir.
Min kawri min kawri e laamɗo jom doole en, ɗaɓɓoowo noddireede ɓurɗo toowde e laamɓe.
Nde banndiraawo am ɗon yewtida bee Allah dow hoosere, lenyol amin ɗon feewna hoore maɓɓe sanamu diga kaŋŋe maɓɓe.
Miin ko mi musiɗɗo Muusaa, toɗɗaaɗo e juuɗe Alla ngam wonde waziir mum, innde mum siftinaama e nder Quraan.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ وَزِيرًۭا
verse: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant. (25:35)
